objective: Convert first-time buyers into repeat buyers

variants.name: First-time buyer — second purchase
variants.audience: Customers with exactly one completed order, excluding contacts already in the win-back journey
variants.rationale: The objective for this group is conversion to a second purchase, which differs from the expansion objective that applies to repeat buyers.

nodes.purpose: Entry on the customer's first completed order
Do not sell again before the first order has arrived
Reassurance and product usage guidance; sets up the relationship before selling
nodes.content_direction: How to use what they bought, with care guidance and support routes

nodes.purpose: Arrive just before the observed first-to-second purchase gap
nodes.timing: observed first-to-second gap minus a lead buffer

nodes.purpose: Affinity-selected next purchase, personalised on the first order
nodes.content_direction: One recommended next product, chosen from observed co-purchase data

nodes.purpose: Remove on purchase or on entry into a higher-priority journey

variants.success_metric: Second-purchase rate among entrants, measured over one full observed interval

rejected_variants.name: High-AOV first-time buyer
rejected_variants.reason: Treatment would be identical to the general first-time buyer journey; the split fails the difference test.

rejected_variants.name: VIP post-purchase
rejected_variants.reason: Audience is below the size needed to read a result; folded in as a branch instead.
